title: Dreamer's Portal
description: A young woman with blue and purple hair sits pensively by a glowing river at sunset, her chin resting on her hand. To the right, a tall dark figure in a patterned coat stands on the opposite bank holding an orb, with a large ornate circular portal floating above him revealing a red-cloaked figure on a path inside a green forest under a starry night sky.
prompt: A contemplative young woman with long blue and purple streaked hair wearing a dark hoodie sits on a grassy riverbank at sunset, resting her chin on her hand. A magical glowing river flows through a lush landscape. On the opposite bank stands a tall mysterious figure in a patterned dark coat holding a glowing orb. Above him floats a large ornate circular portal decorated with flowers and crescent moons, showing a surreal scene inside with a red hooded figure walking a path through a glowing green forest under a starry night sky with comets.
